title: Moto Guzzi Stelvio 1200 (Special Edition)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Aprilia Moto Guzzi Stelvio 1200 (Special Edition) is tuned for spirited street performance with an intuitive wide-handlebar command. At its heart lies a 1200cc powertrain delivering 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 228 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 19.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
